# Applied Theory (Adriel Tang)

> Adriel Tang is a full stack developer in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia, working mainly in ASP.NET Core, C#, Flutter and Dart. He builds websites, web apps, backend APIs with databases, and cross-platform mobile apps, and takes freelance projects.
